description: Approved-peptide clinical PK reference distributions and curated peptide panel reference ranges for ADMET-AI-style percentile contextualization across all 47 endpoints.

sources.approved_clinical_peptides: Factual FDA/DailyMed prescribing information (`clinical_evidence_index.json`), Case17 FDA clinical peptide benchmark, and 2019-2023 FDA blind set (`v33_manifest.json`).
sources.curated_peptide_panel: Case17 17-drug clinical peptide V33 reference profiles and empirical corpus bounds from `v33_manifest.json`.
